dataset: Rutherford Reach Water Quality Dataset, 2026-2027 field season
extract_of: Passaic River Water Watch field records
extract_note: Live field season records. Every record Passaic River Water Watch has collected this season at station NBC-01.
author: Haolin Li

station.name: Nereid Boat Club dock, Rutherford, New Jersey
station.coordinate_precision_note: published to two decimal places deliberately
station.water: Lower Passaic River, tidal, below the Dundee Dam
station.sampling_window: Sundays, early evening; Mondays on laboratory split weeks

methods.field: Coliscan Easygel, 5 mL, duplicate plates, 24 h at 35 C, purple to dark blue colonies counted as E. coli; pink, red and magenta recorded as other coliforms and not counted; teal and white not counted
methods.reported_value: mean of the two duplicate plates, colonies on a 5 mL plate multiplied by 20
methods.antecedent_rainfall: project rain gauge at the boathouse, 48 hours before the sample

criteria.source: EPA Recreational Water Quality Criteria, 2012, and the 1986 bacteria criteria

records.monitoring_location_name: Nereid Boat Club dock, Rutherford, New Jersey
records.coordinate_precision_note: published to two decimal places deliberately; one sampler at a fixed dock
records.analytical_method_name: Coliscan Easygel, 5 mL, duplicate plates, 24 h at 35 C
records.result_comment: mean of duplicate plates, 120 and 85 colonies on 5 mL nominal; counted as ranges, 100 to 140 and 70 to 100, midpoint average 102.5 colonies; plated volume: five full-bulb transfer-pipette draws; calibrated after the fact against a test tube with a 5 mL mark, three such draws consistently reach 5 mL, so one draw is about 1.67 mL and the plated volume was about 8.3 mL; colonies divided by 8.33 mL times 100 gives a multiplier of 12
records.antecedent_rain_source: Teterboro Airport ASOS, about 3 mi NE of the dock; project gauge not yet installed
